# Lady Nails

> Nail salon & nail art based in Round Rock, Texas. Gel manicures, pedicures, acrylic and SNS dip sets and hand-painted nail art at 1100 E Palm Valley Blvd in Round Rock. Friendly, quick and easy on your wallet since 1994.

- Phone: (512) 218-9736
- Based in: Round Rock, TX
- Nearby areas: Round Rock, Hutto, Pflugerville, Georgetown, Cedar Park, Austin
- Google rating: 4.6 from 165 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/lady-nails/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/lady-nails/book.html

## Services
- Gel manicure: A glossy gel manicure that looks amazing and doesn't take all afternoon.
- Pedicure: Thorough pedicures that leave your toes looking and feeling beautiful. Got time? Regulars swear by the deluxe pedicure.
- Full sets, acrylic & SNS dip: Acrylic and SNS dip powder sets in coffin, almond or stiletto, short or long, in any color.
- Hand-painted nail art: Hearts, ghosts, polka dots, zebra print and cartoon characters, painted by hand.
- Charms, bows & rhinestones: 3D bows, gold studs, charms and rhinestones for a little extra sparkle.
- Ombre, glitter & French: Glitter ombre, soft grey fades and colored French tips.

## About
Lady Nails has served Round Rock since 1994, and these days you'll find it at 1100 E Palm Valley Blvd, under the pink LADY NAILS sign. Reviewers call it a family-run shop, and it shows: some regulars have been coming for 12 and 15+ years, one since she was a teenager, and one mom's daughter has been coming since she was 8. What they mention most: the work is fast, careful and thorough, the prices beat most places, and everyone is kind. Then there's the art: hot pink glitter ombre, gold foil, 3D bows, sunflowers, and hand-painted Tweety and Halloween nails.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Thursday 9:30 AM to 7 PM, Friday 9 AM to 7 PM, Saturday 9 AM to 6:30 PM. Closed Sunday.
- Q: Where is Lady Nails?
  A: 1100 E Palm Valley Blvd, Round Rock, TX 78664. Look for the pink LADY NAILS sign.
- Q: How long have you been open?
  A: Lady Nails has served Round Rock since 1994. Some clients have been coming for more than 15 years.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome. Busy times can mean a wait, so call (512) 218-9736 ahead and you'll be in and out much faster.
- Q: Do you do acrylic and SNS dip powder?
  A: Yes. Gel, acrylic full sets and fills, and SNS dip powder, in any shape and length.
- Q: Do you do nails for kids and men?
  A: Yes. Lady Nails does nails for women, kids and men. One regular's daughter has been coming since she was 8.
- Q: Can you do custom nail art?
  A: Yes. Hearts, ghosts, sunflowers, polka dots, zebra print, cartoon characters, gold foil, 3D bows, charms and rhinestones. Bring a photo of the look you want.
- Q: Can I request a specific nail tech?
  A: Yes. Many regulars ask for Linda, Trinity or Debbie by name. Just mention who you'd like when you call.
